# MKS’ Atotech to showcase solutions for electrification, renewable energy and sustainable surface finishing at SF China 2026


**Berlin, November 03, 2026 –** MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, will participate in SF China 2026, taking place November 11–13 in Guangzhou, China.


As industries continue to advance electrification, renewable energy deployment, and more sustainable manufacturing practices, demand is growing for surface finishing technologies that improve performance, durability, and efficiency while supporting environmental goals.


In line with these trends, MKS’ Atotech will present solutions for a wide range of applications, including:


- Surface treatment solutions for battery components, including connectors, busbars, current collectors, and battery housings supporting next-generation electric vehicle architectures
- Decorative and functional finishes that combine aesthetics, performance, and durability across a wide range of industrial and consumer applications
- Advanced corrosion protection and wear-resistant technologies designed for demanding operating environments
- Sustainable alternatives that help manufacturers address evolving environmental requirements, including hexavalent chromium-free and non-PFAS-containing solutions


MKS’ Atotech experts will be available throughout the show to discuss how advanced surface finishing technologies can help manufacturers improve durability, efficiency and sustainability.


We look forward to welcoming customers, partners, and industry professionals at **Booth 5.1D13.**


**Event:** SF China
**Date:** November 11–13, 2026
**Booth:** 5.1D13
**Venue:** China Import and Export Fair Complex, Guangzhou


For more information, please visit:[https://www.sfchina.net/](https://www.sfchina.net/) .
